SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

C.S. // File No.
DATE 21 / 12 / 30.
Gordon Road Station,
Date December 25, 1930.

Subject (in full) Report on the attached.

Made by D.S.I. Crawford Forwarded by [签名] C.I.

Sir,
The birthday party was held on the 14/12/30, at the
Foh Sing Yuen Restaurant, Foochow Road, in celebration of the birth-
day of C.D.S.I. Sung Dzoong Li's mother who is 70 years of age,
but the birthday celebration were arranged by the C.D.S.I.'s
brother, 80 people, mostly relatives, attended the birthday party,
and the invitations were sent out by his brother, the C.D.S.I.
having no part in the invitation, therefore he thought that as
his brother were managing the party it was un-necessary for him
to apply for permission to hold the party.

Enquiries have been made at the address, 1007 Car-
ter Road, which is the Carter Road Lodging House, but no person of
the name given on the envelope is registered in the books.

One man of the same name as appears on the enve-
lope is known to the C.D.S.I. and is employed as a bamboo coolie
foreman by I.W.K. No. 5 Hill, Pootoo Road District. This man was
interviewed, but denies all knowledge of the contents of the let-
ter, or that a birthday party was held by the C.D.S.I.'s family.
Further more, this person can neither read nor write.

D.S.I.

D.D.O. "B" Div. [签名]
[手写批注]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

C.S. // 档案编号
日期 1930年12月21日。
戈登路捕房，
日期 1930年12月25日。

主题（全称）关于附件的报告。

由副巡官克劳福德（Crawford）呈报 转呈人 [签名] 总巡官

先生，
生日宴会于1930年12月14日在福州路福兴园酒家举行，以庆祝华籍副总巡宋仲礼（Sung Dzoong Li）之母七十寿辰，但生日庆典系由该华籍副总巡之兄筹办，出席生日宴会者共80人，多为亲属，请柬亦由其兄发出，该华籍副总巡并未参与邀请事宜，因此他认为既然由其兄操办宴会，便无需申请举办宴会的许可。

已就信封上所列地址卡特路1007号进行查询，该处为卡特路寄宿公寓，但登记簿中并无信封上所署姓名之人注册。

华籍副总巡认识一名与信封上所署姓名相同之人，此人在普陀路地段第五山丘国际工程公司（I.W.K.）受雇为竹工头目。已对此人进行问话，但他否认知悉信件内容，也否认华籍副总巡家属曾举办生日宴会。此外，此人不识文字。

副巡官

“B”区副总监 [签名]
[手写批注]

pages.en:
Translation of the attached (? anonymous letter).

(Undated).

R.C. Alers Esquire,
D.C. (C. & S.B.).

Sir,

I have to inform you that C.D.S.I. Sung Tsoong-li
of Gordon Road Police Station will hold a feast, for
which four or five hundred invitations were distributed
among the loafers of the Gordon Road district, in the
Foh Sing Yuen Restaurant at Bing Vong Ka, Foochow Road,
at 6 or 7 p.m. on December 14 in celebration of the
birthday of his mother. Such an act reflects discredit
on the reputation of the Municipal Council.

Tsang Chin-wan.
Address on the envelope: No. 1007 Carter Road.

7.
500 B
Any permission
16/12

S. Det yo Ev G Rd
For report.
W.M.K.
23/12/30

致 R.C. Alers 先生，
刑事及政治部主任助理委员。

先生，

本人谨告知，戈登路捕房华籍副总巡宋仲礼（Sung Tsoong-li）将举办宴席，为此向戈登路地区的游手好闲之徒分发了四五百份请柬，定于12月14日下午6或7时，在福州北河南路口的福兴园酒家，为其母庆祝生日。此举有损工部局之声誉。

曾金万（Tsang Chin-wan）。
信封上的地址：卡特路1007号。

7.
500 B
